title: Jammy Dense Russian Bread
description: A hearty, low-carb-friendly Russian bread featuring strong white bread flour and a jammy crust.
instructions: Combine flour, salt, and yeast in a large mixing bowl. Mix in warm water until a shaggy dough forms.
Add sugar, egg, jam, and butter to the dough. Mix until a sticky ball forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape into a round loaf.
Place the loaf in a steamy oven or a steam-injected oven for 25 minutes at 375°F.
Remove the bread from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
Transfer the bread to a plate or cutting board and let cool completely.
